title: Opinion Verbs: Saying You Do Not Think So
goal: Use the indicative after opinion verbs and the subjunctive after the same verbs with no, and place the no correctly.

sections.title: Unit 5: Doubt, Denial and Opinion
body: At B2 you give opinions, but you also doubt, deny and politely disagree with other people's opinions. This unit is about the moods of that kind of conversation.

You will practise opinion verbs with and without no, verbs of doubt and denial, the pattern no es que… sino que… for correcting a reason, expressions of possibility for hedging an opinion, and how to put them together to disagree politely. The unit ends with a short text about the Mexican writer Octavio Paz and his book of essays El laberinto de la soledad.

items: I can use no creo que and no me parece que with the subjunctive.
I can tell creo que no with the indicative from no creo que with the subjunctive.
I can use the new words for opinions and beliefs.
